Die Lage mitten in den Hutongs ist grundsätzlich interessant und gut, allerdings auch problematisch. Die Gassen sind so eng, dass größere Taxis oder Vans das Hotel nicht erreichen können. Mit viel Gepäck ist das sehr unpraktisch.

Unser Zimmer war zudem sehr feucht, was den Aufenthalt deutlich beeinträchtigt hat. Ein weiterer Minuspunkt: Vom Eingangsbereich bis zu den Zimmern gibt es keine Überdachung. Bei Regen wird man mit Gepäck komplett nass.

Insgesamt hat uns das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis enttäuscht. Kühlschrank und TV haben auch nicht funktioniert. Während unserer gesamten China-Reise war dies mit Abstand die Unterkunft mit dem schlechtesten Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis. Für den aufgerufenen Preis hätten wir einen deutlich besseren Standard erwartet.
translatedContent:
The location in the heart of the hutongs is interesting and convenient, but also problematic. The alleyways are so narrow that larger taxis or vans can't reach the hotel. This is very inconvenient with a lot of luggage.

Our room was also very damp, which significantly impacted our stay. Another drawback: there's no shelter from the entrance to the rooms. If it rains, you and your luggage will get completely soaked.

Overall, we were disappointed with the value for money. The refrigerator and TV didn't work either. During our entire trip to China, this was by far the worst accommodation for our money. For the price, we expected a much higher standard.

feedbackContent: 非常遺憾給您帶來不好的體驗，對於房間牆面出現的意外狀況，我們向您真誠道歉！如果您當時前往前台告知情況，我們或許能提供更好的解決方案。小院坐落於擁有數百年歷史的建築內，地處老城衚衕核心保護區，體驗北京胡同本身就是旅行中重要的一環。門前道路屬於公共通路，允許車輛通行，平日裏一直有各類車輛往來。車輛無法駛入院內，通常是車型選擇錯誤或是司機不願進入。您當時並未向我們提及這項難題，我們無法及時協助處理。大路口距離此處僅步行 5 分鐘，全程水泥路面，推行李完全不受影響。正如您所説，若攜帶大量行李，建議預訂面積更大、設施更佳的房型。平台所有房型圖片與文字介紹訊息完整，可供您充分判斷。相信您預訂前對比過多家同類四合院民宿價格，最終選擇了性價比最優的我們。預算有限的情況下，需要合理調整心理預期。當前正值北京雨季，空氣濕度很高，古建築普遍存在返潮難題，我們也長期受此困擾。每位客人入住前，工作人員都會仔細檢查房間，正常不會出現您照片裏的情況。您退房後客房人員現場核實，牆面痕跡是淋雨潮濕後大件行李箱摩擦剮蹭造成。考慮到希望您擁有愉快的中國之行，我們沒有向您提出索賠，但本次事件已同步反饋預訂平台。客房冰箱、電視均可正常使用。倘若您不清楚設備使用方式卻沒有主動詢問，我們難以提供幫助，冰箱脱離電源自然無法運轉。您預訂的是緊湊房型，卻攜帶體積龐大的行李。我們如同對待親友一般熱忱服務，收穫的卻是嚴苛的指責，對於您這般挑剔的態度，我們深感失望。在您入住期間，我們全程熱情接待，幫忙搬運行李、遞送雨傘、指引路線。您可以使用前廳舒適區域，也能在露台花園靜坐閲讀；常有流浪貓遠遠和客人打招呼。管家也可以根據需求推薦高性價比餐館，這正是中國人待客之道。北京民眾熱情好客，但我們衹歡迎友善的朋友。世界遼闊，祝願您往後旅途擁有更好的體驗。Es tut uns sehr leid, dass Ihr Aufenthalt nicht zufriedenstellend verlaufen ist. The most important thing to know is the Peking Yard Boutique Hotel is not a boutique hotel, it's a youth hostel with private rooms for rent. It may have once been a boutique hotel as there's an award from 2021 in the dining area, but those days feel long gone.

I rented double bedroom in the sunshine courtyard. I've no idea where the room is in the photos, but this wasn't my experience. The room was small, cramped, windowless (apart from a skylight) and smelt damp. The AC unit sounded like a jetpack and there wasn't any electricity in the morning or a working overhead shower. For full clarity there was a separate hand held shower, and I gather the mains electricity was being dug up in the hutong the hostel is located in.

I checked out two days early as it wasn't for me, receiving a partial refund. If I'd been 20 years younger and arriving with a backpack and a couple of mates it might have been a different story.

Les espaces communs sont agréables et cosy.

Concernant la chambre, bien qu'elle soit tout à fait correcte, cela a été une légère déception.
En effet, j'avais réservé une chambre double Tatami avec un puit de lumière et je me suis retrouvé dans une chambre double classique, qui manquait de fait cruellement de place.
Il fut très compliqué d'ouvrir nos valises, l'espace est restreint par la banquette et le fauteuil. La douche est très bien et agréable mais l'ensemble de la salle de bain manque d'intimité, surtout les toilettes (on peut voir entre la porte et le mur). Enfin, il n'y a pas de crochet pour suspendre les serviettes mouillées, on ne sait donc pas quoi en faire.

Bref, peut-être que ça aurait été mieux si on avait respecté mon choix de chambre mais en l'état, je suis un peu déçu.

Mais cela reste un petit hôtel très charmant et agréable pour ceux qui voyagent léger.
translatedContent:
The hotel is absolutely charming, located in a quiet hutong and very close to the metro and shops.

The common areas are pleasant and cozy.

Regarding the room, although perfectly adequate, it was a slight disappointment.

I had booked a Tatami double room with a skylight and ended up in a standard double room, which was consequently very cramped.
It was very difficult to open our suitcases, as the space was restricted by the sofa and armchair. The shower was very nice and pleasant, but the entire bathroom lacked privacy, especially the toilet (you could see through the door and into the wall). Finally, there was no hook for hanging wet towels, so there was nothing to do with them.

In short, perhaps it would have been better if they had respected my room choice, but as it was, I was a little disappointed.

However, it remains a very charming and pleasant little hotel for those traveling light.

content:
Останавливались в отеле на 3 ночи в марте 2026 года в Пекине — остались очень довольны.

Отличное расположение: до метро всего 4–5 минут пешком. Однако из-за расположения в хутуне (узкие улочки) такси не подъезжает прямо к входу — обычно высаживают на повороте с основной улицы, что стоит учитывать при наличии тяжелого багажа.

Сервис на высоком уровне: персонал очень дружелюбный, всегда готов помочь, хорошо говорит по-английски и при необходимости уверенно пользуется переводчиком. Общение также удобно организовано через WeChat.

В отеле есть бесплатный и хорошо работающий Wi-Fi.

Номера чистые, но компактные (примерно 5×5 м в стандарте) и с повышенной влажностью.

Отдельно хочется отметить завтраки — великолепные. На выбор около 8 позиций, попробовали 4 — все были очень вкусные.

Обязательно порекомендуем друзьям и близким. В следующий визит в Пекин останемся в этом же отеле.
translatedContent:
We stayed at this hotel for 3 nights in March 2026 in Beijing and were very pleased.

The location is excellent: just a 4-5-minute walk from the metro. However, due to the location in a hutong (narrow streets), taxis don't come right to the entrance; they usually drop you off at a turn off the main street, which is worth considering if you have heavy luggage.

The service is excellent: the staff is very friendly, always willing to help, speaks good English, and confidently uses a translator when needed. Communication is also conveniently organized via WeChat.

The hotel has free, well-functioning Wi-Fi.

The rooms are clean but compact (approximately 5x5 meters for a standard room) and have high humidity.

I'd especially like to mention the breakfasts – they were excellent. There are about 8 options to choose from, we tried 4, and all were delicious.

We will definitely recommend this hotel to friends and family. We'll stay at the same hotel on our next visit to Beijing.

roomTypeName: Special Sunshine Courtyard Queen Room (Spa-Grade Soft Water, Central Air Conditioning, Smart Toilet. Compact Room; Large Luggage Is Not Recommended)
feedbackContent: 親愛的朋友，抱歉讓您覺得侷促，小院本身是個文保建築，所有房間必須遵循原有的建築規制，設計師已在極限範圍內改建並斬獲設計大獎，修舊如舊讓古建築變得更生動。所在地區平均房價20+萬元/平米，四合院的建築形式限制了房間面積。歡迎您下次感受其他房型，loft和套房都是2間房改建，會寬敞很多哦~感謝您的真實好評！房間雖緊湊，但乾淨舒適、足夠安心休息，我們也會繼續把服務和細節做得更好～期待您下次再來北京，繼續來小院住得自在、玩得開心！
feedbackTranslateContent: Dear friend, we apologize for making you feel cramped. The courtyard is a protected historical building, and all rooms had to adhere to the original building regulations. We look forward to your next visit to Beijing and hope you will enjoy a comfortable and happy stay at our courtyard!

content: 房間衞生差，親子房內樓下冷了，開空調樓上巨熱，樓下冷。室內發現蟑螂溝通後並無任何進一步解決方式！住過這麼多酒店，對於酒店服務漏洞溝通最差的一家！
translatedContent: The room hygiene was poor. In the family room, it was cold downstairs, but when we turned on the air conditioning, it got incredibly hot upstairs while still being cold downstairs. We found cockroaches and after communicating this, no further solutions were provided! Of all the hotels I've stayed in, this one had the worst communication regarding service issues!
roomTypeName: Loft Family Suite [Hot Spring-Quality Soft Water + Smart Toilet + Skylight + Central Air Conditioning]
feedbackContent: 尊敬的賓客，您反饋的每一個問題都是我們我們非常關注的重點問題！酒店一直都有專業公司定期按照消殺制度消殺，從未出有過出現蟑螂以及其他蟲子的情況，由於四合院的建築性質，本身花園綠植較多，出現蚊蟲在所難免，酒店除正常衞生清潔外，在您入住之前都會仔細對房間進行兩次以上的衞生檢查，確保在您入住之前絕不可能會出現有蚊蟲的情況。您入住時一切美好並表達了喜愛，接連幾天並未提出異常，臨近退房，拍了張乾巴的蟑螂照片來前台説要求給個説法，並説明您是攜程的老會員，對攜程的要求非常瞭解等。店長給您的解決方案是：1、首先我們不知情蟑螂的來源，但是房間有蟑螂出現讓您覺得不適，為您換房或者馬上無條件退房，退還未發生房費。但是您已經入住幾日，之前並未收到任何類似問題反饋，肯定無法按照整單退。2、出於抱歉，在您已經享用歡迎水果的前提下，又額外贈送了一份果盤，並提出可以送您咖啡或者飲品或者您用餐折扣等，但您接受了水果，仍然要求給一個解決方案。您拿低分差評來要求酒店為您房費全額退款我們確實不解也無能為力，至於房內温度的問題因為loft房型結構特殊空調裝在靠近屋頂的位置，酒店地暖也一直是正常開放的，您在地暖温度達標的房間將空調温度調製30多度然後對房間温度不滿，不知是何用意！儘管如此，出現問題後酒店馬上調取了您入住幾日公區的監控，同時再次立刻安排專人對親子房及全店衞生進行全面排查消殺，對服務以及前台工作人員嚴格培訓，並且檢查調試了每個房間的空調，同時嚴肅整改服務流程！酒店一直將每位入住的客人視為家人，前台小姐姐小哥哥也一直對每位客人入住期間的任何問題盡最大的能力提供幫助，不知是哪位工作人員無意間得罪您還是您有面臨其他事情讓您如此不滿大動肝火，如果您覺得這種行為可以要挾到酒店並製造恐慌，那不好意思，我們還是會誠摯接待每位入住的客人！休想因為刻意的要挾抹殺我們所有人的努力和用心付出，有問題我們可以溝通，有問題我們會積極承認錯誤並誠懇的道歉、也會盡量徵得諒解和改正的機會，原則問題是我們的底線，這個差評我們願意保留作為警醒，下次再遇到此類問題會要求當班工作人員報警處理，請原諒我們屬實不能退讓，謝謝！
feedbackTranslateContent: Dear Guest, every issue you raised is a key concern for us! Our hotel has a professional company that regularly performs pest control according to established procedures, and we have never had cockroaches or other insects. However, due to the courtyard-style architecture and the abundance of greenery in the garden, the presence of insects is unavoidable. In addition to routine cleaning, the hotel conducts at least two thorough hygiene checks on your room before your check-in to ensure there are absolutely no insects present. You expressed your satisfaction with your stay and did not raise any issues for several days. However, near check-out, you sent a photo of a dried-out cockroach to the front desk demanding an explanation, stating that you are a long-time member of Ctrip and are very familiar with Ctrip's requirements. The manager's proposed solution is: 1. We are unaware of the source of the cockroaches, but the presence of cockroaches in the room made you uncomfortable. We would either change your room or offer an immediate, unconditional refund, including a full refund of the unused room rate. However, since you have already stayed for several days and we did not receive any similar feedback beforehand, we cannot offer a full refund. 2. Out of apologies, we offered an extra fruit platter after you had already enjoyed the welcome fruit, and offered to provide you with coffee or other drinks, or a discount on your meal. However, you accepted the fruit and still requested a solution. We are truly puzzled and unable to help you with your low rating and demand a full refund of your room fee. Regarding the room temperature issue, due to the unique structure of the loft room, the air conditioner is installed near the roof, and the hotel's underfloor heating was always on. Your dissatisfaction with the room temperature after setting the air conditioner to over 30 degrees Celsius in a room where the underfloor heating was adequate is unclear. Nevertheless, after the issue arose, the hotel immediately reviewed the surveillance footage from the public areas during your stay. We also immediately arranged for a thorough inspection and disinfection of the family rooms and the entire hotel, rigorously trained service and front desk staff, checked and adjusted the air conditioning in every room, and seriously rectified our service procedures! The hotel treats every guest like family, and the front desk staff always strive to assist guests with any issues during their stay. We are unsure whether a staff member unintentionally offended you or if you faced other matters that caused your dissatisfaction and anger. If you believe this behavior can intimidate the hotel and create panic, we regret to inform you that we will continue to sincerely welcome every guest! Please do not attempt to negate all our hard work and dedication through deliberate coercion. We can communicate, and we will readily admit our mistakes and sincerely apologize, while also seeking your understanding and a chance to correct our errors. However, matters of principle are our bottom line. We are willing to retain this negative review as a warning, and in the future, we will request the on-duty staff to call the police if a similar issue arises. Please forgive us, but we cannot back down. Thank you!

來北京最正確的決定，就是選了這家四合院酒店！一腳踏入青磚灰瓦的院落，紅柱繞樑、燈籠垂掛，瞬間隔絕了外界的車水馬龍，老北京的韻味撲面而來。最驚喜的是酒店自帶的咖啡廳，古色古香的庭院裏擺着原木桌椅，陽光透過玻璃頂灑在桌面，點一杯拿鐵，醇厚香氣混着院子裏的草木清香，中西碰撞的奇妙體驗讓人沉醉。
休息區更是寶藏角落，柔和燈光與雅緻綠植，既有傳統中式的莊重典雅，又不失現代設計的舒適實用。感受“閑庭信步”的慢生活，北平的愜意不過如此。
酒店位置超便利，步行可達地鐵站和熱門衚衕，卻能鬧中取靜詮釋“大隱隱於市”的意境。不管是想體驗老北京文化，還是單純找個地方放鬆身心，這裏都完美契合。從咖啡香到庭院風，從貼心服務到沉浸體驗，全程滿分，下次來北京一定再住！
translatedContent:
The best decision I made on my trip to Beijing was choosing this Siheyuan (courtyard) hotel! Stepping into the courtyard with its grey bricks and tiles, red pillars, and hanging lanterns, instantly shut out the city's hustle and bustle, immersing me in the authentic charm of old Beijing.

The biggest surprise was the hotel's own cafe. In the quaint courtyard, with its antique feel, wooden tables and chairs were set out. Sunlight streamed through the glass ceiling onto the tabletops. Sipping a latte, the rich aroma mixed with the fresh scent of the plants in the courtyard – a wonderful blend of East and West that was truly captivating.

The lounge area was another hidden gem. With its soft lighting and elegant greenery, it perfectly combined the solemn elegance of traditional Chinese style with the comfort and practicality of modern design. It was the ideal spot to experience the slow pace of 'strolling leisurely in the courtyard,' embodying the relaxed atmosphere of Beiping (old Beijing).

The hotel's location is super convenient, within walking distance to the subway station and popular hutongs, yet it remains a quiet sanctuary amidst the busy city, perfectly illustrating the concept of 'great reclusion in the city.' Whether you want to experience old Beijing culture or simply find a place to relax, this hotel is a perfect fit. From the aroma of coffee to the courtyard ambiance, from attentive service to an immersive experience, everything was full marks. I will definitely stay here again on my next visit to Beijing!
